source: 589 Object Within the Nest
target: 589 Res in Nido

source: 589 Object Within the Nest
target: 589 Res in Nido

source: As Lumian’s Astral Projection expanded with the power of the sea, he immediately sensed the presence of the “waters.”
target: Cum proiectio astralis Luminiani cum potentia maris expandebatur, statim praesentiam “aquarum” sensit.

source: This wasn’t a genuine ocean but a fantastical sea created by radiant starlight.
target: Non erat oceanus verus, sed mare phantasticum a radiante luce stellarum creatum.

source: At its core lay the projection of the silver-gray behemoth.
target: In medio eius iacebat proiectio ingentis bestiae cinereo‑argenteae.

source: Empowered by an ample supply of the sea’s power, Lumian’s Astral Projection surged forward, merging seamlessly with the phantom.
target: Virtute maris copiosae ditata, proiectio astralis Luminiani impetum fecit, cum phantasma perfecte coalescens.

source: A burning sensation radiated from the left side of his chest, as if some form of acknowledgment had been received.
target: Sensatio ardens ex parte sinistra pectoris eius emanabat, quasi aliqua forma agnitionis accepisset.

source: His consciousness extended boundlessly, taking command of the dreamlike illusory sea.
target: Conscientia eius sine fine extendebatur, imperium capiens in mari somniorum illusorio.

source: In the course of this process, he glimpsed the phantoms of Juan Oro, Ultraman Lato Guiaro, and unfamiliar apparitions.
target: In hoc processu perspexit phantasmata Juan Oro, Ultraman Lato Guiaro, atque apparitiones ignotas.

source: Those who have returned to the sea?
target: Qui ad mare redierunt?

source: They seem to have transformed into water droplets in the sea…
target: Videbantur quasi guttae aquae in mari conversa.

source: Lumian withdrew his gaze from the joyful Juan Oro and the pained Lato Guiaro, redirecting it toward the depths of the tunnel ahead.
target: Lumian conspectum suum a laeto Juan Oro et dolenti Lato Guiaro abstulit, eumque versus profunda tunelis prae oculis direxit.

source: From a considerable distance, he spotted Mad Lady.
target: Ex longinquo, Mad Lady conspexit.

source: The silver-gray behemoth harbored entities nurtured within the flesh and blood “bird’s nest.”
target: Bestia cinereo‑argentea complexa entia gerebat, quae in nidore carnis et sanguinis nutrita erant.

source: With the Batings Black Insect, Little Devils, and other extraterrestrial life forms, it was inevitable that they coexisted in the spirit world.
target: Cum Batings Black Insect, Parvis Diabolis, et aliis formis vitae extraterrestris, inevitabile erat eos in mundo spirituum coesse.

source: However, this spirit world was entirely severed from the external realm.
target: Sed hic mundus spirituum omnino a regione externa separatus erat.

source: Consequently, Beyonders skilled in summoning creatures from the spirit world for assistance found themselves bereft of their primary reliance.
target: Itaque Beyonders, qui in evocando creaturas ex mundo spirituum ad auxilium periti erant, suam principalem fiduciam amisere.

source: Teleportation executed through the spirit world, however, retained some semblance of normalcy.
target: Translocatio per mundum spirituum, tamen, aliquam normalitatis speciem retinebat.

source: Departing directly, however, proved impossible.
target: Sed directe discedere impossibile erat.

source: The only avenues were through the energy passageway at the entrance or by breaching the outer wall to connect the inner and outer spirit worlds.
target: Unica via erant per viam energiae ad introitum, aut per ruinationem parietis exterioris ad coniungendum mundos spirituum internum et externum.

source: Simultaneously, the closer one approached the flesh-and-blood “bird’s nest,” the more peculiar the spirit world became.
target: Simul, quanto propius quis ad nidum carnis et sanguinis accedebat, tanto mirabilius mundus spirituum fiebat.

source: It was as though the air gradually thickened, becoming almost tangible and impeding the approach of “birds.”
target: Veluti si aer paulatim densaret, fere tangibilis fieret ac accessum “avium” impedit.

source: In such an environment, coupled with the absence of a flesh-and-blood “bird’s nest,” Mad Lady found herself unable to teleport directly.
target: In tali ambitu, cum absens esset nido carnis et sanguinis, Mad Lady directe se translocare non potuit.

source: Her only recourse was to Blink incrementally, expending her spirituality with each maneuver.
target: Unicum eius remedium fuit paulatim “Blink” facere, spiritualitatem suam singulis motibus expendens.

source: Having focused on Mad Lady and the space in front of her, Lumian suddenly extended his right hand and clenched it into a fist.
target: Cum Mad Lady et spatium ante eam intenderit, Lumian subito dextram manum protulit et in pugnaculum contraxit.

source: The air surrounding Mad Lady immediately grew dense, as if assuming a tangible form.
target: Aer circum Mad Lady statim densatus est, quasi forma tangibilis assumeretur.

source: This transformation caused the illusory curtain to bend, compressing the corresponding area into a dark and transparent sphere.
target: Haec transformatio velam illusorium flectere provocavit, regionem congruentem in sphaeram obscuram atque transparentem comprimendo efficiebat.

source: Once more, Mad Lady’s form disappeared, but a formless force, shaped by the bending area, yanked her out and sent her plummeting.
target: Iterum forma Mad Lady evanuit, sed vis informis, quae a regione flexa formata erat, eam attulit et deiecit.

source: Under the authority of the Governor of the Sea, the spirit world within the sphere and the spirit world within the silver-gray behemoth were forcibly separated!
target: Sub auctoritate Praefecti Maris, mundus spirituum intra sphaeram et mundus spirituum intra bestiam cinereo‑argenteam coacte separati sunt!

source: However, this effect was contingent on the peculiar environment.
target: Tamen hic effectus ex ambitu peculiario pendebat.

source: In the external world, given Lumian’s current level and mastery of the power of the sea, completely isolating an area from the expansive and genuine spirit world proved challenging.
target: In mundo externo, dato gradu Luminiani et dominio potentiae maris, secernere omnino regionem a vasto et vero mundo spirituum difficillimum apparuit.

source: He could merely employ Cosmic Void to create an exit path and a door symbolizing an escape route, a tactic vulnerable to counteraction by a Traveler’s abilities.
target: Unicum eius remedium erat uti “Cosmic Void” ad viam exitus et ostium repraesentans evasionis iter creandum, consilium autem ab facultatibus viatoris facile oppugnandum.

source: Mad Lady attempted another Blink, yet found herself unable to escape the dark sphere’s confines.
target: Mad Lady alium “Blink” conata est, sed se ex confinibus sphaerae obscurae liberare non potuisse invenit.

source: She halted in place, seriously contemplating her Recorded abilities and the items in her possession that might alleviate her current predicament.
target: In loco cessavit, serio de facultatibus “Recorded” suis atque rebus in sua possessione, quae condicionem eius levare possent, meditans.

source: Observing her struggle, Lumian couldn’t suppress his yearning for demigod‑level powers.
target: Eius luctationem contemplans, Lumian desiderium suum pro facultatibus quasi semideificis reprimere non potuit.

source: As the temporary authority‑wielding Governor of the Sea—essentially a faux demigod incapable of withstanding a single spell from the “Cinderella” demigod—Lumian had ensnared Mad Lady in an inescapable dilemma.
target: Ut gubernator maris temporarius auctoritate praeditus—prorsus quasi falsus demideus, incapax una tantum incantatione demideus “Cinderella” sustinere—Lumian Mad Lady in dilemma ineluctabile incidit.

source: She proved challenging even for Mr. K to subdue in a brief timeframe.
target: Illa etiam pro Mr. K in brevi tempore subducere difficillime videbatur.

source: Mad Lady gazed into the depths of the metal tunnel, representing the flesh and blood “bird’s nest,” her face aglow with unrestrained eagerness, anticipation, and excitement.
target: Mad Lady in profundum tuneli metallici, quod “nidum” carnis et sanguinis repraesentat, aspexit, vultu fulgenti impetu, exspectatione, atque alacrietate.

source: Confined within the dark sphere, she yearned for escape, dissatisfied with her inability to reach the desired destination.
target: Inclusa in sphaera obscura, evasionem desiderabat, indignata sua incapacitate ad metam attingendam.

source: Head over there, quick!
target: Vade illuc, cito!

source: Head over there, quick!
target: Vade illuc, cito!

source: I want to go over!
target: Volo ire illuc!

source: The longing in her heart intensified, nearly manifesting as a tangible desire.
target: Desiderium in corde eius in intensitatem crevit, paene quasi in cupiditatem tangibilem efferens.

source: The desire surged into her chest, seeking to rupture the restraints and liberate her from this predicament.
target: Desiderium in pectore eius irruit, quaerens vincula rumpere atque eam ex hac condicione liberare.

source: Mr. K, having switched to a Traveler’s soul, swiftly caught up and saw Mad Lady.
target: Mr. K, animam viatoris adoptans, celeriter ivit et Mad Lady conspexit.

source: Instinctively, an illusory book materialized in his dark eyes.
target: Instinctu, liber illusorius in oculis eius obscuris apparuit.

source: Positioned in front of Mr. K, the book flipped through its pages while chanting in a low voice, “I came, I saw, I record.”
target: Ante Mr. K positus, liber paginas suas volvens voce humilis incantans dixebat: “Veni, vidi, notavi.”

source: In an instant, Mr. K underwent a transformation, manifesting as a two to three‑meter‑tall half‑giant donned in cold black armor, brandishing a dark, straight broadsword.
target: In momento, Mr. K transformationem subiit, apparens tamquam semigeus duorum ad trium metrorum altus, indutus armatura nigra frigida, gladium rectum obscurum gerens.

source: Having Grazed a Traveler, he had selected three Beyonder powers: Blink, Record, and the Traveler’s Door, encompassing teleportation or travel.
target: Cum Viatorem laesisset, tres potentias Beyonder seligit: “Blink”, “Record”, et “Portam Viatoris”, quae teleportationem aut iter complectuntur.

source: Additionally, with Record, he had acquired an ability capable of influencing godhood from a Saint of the Aurora Order.
target: Insuper, per “Record”, adeptus erat facultatem divinitatem influere, ab Sancto Ordinis Aurorae.

source: While only half as effective as the original, it proved sufficient to contend with Mad Lady, who had yet to approach the threshold of godhood.
target: Quamvis tantum dimidia efficacia habeat quam originalis, sufficiens erat ad contendendum cum Mad Lady, quae etiam ad limen divinitatis non accesserat.

source: Mr. K advanced confidently, wielding the dark, straight broadsword, prepared to strike.
target: Mr. K fiduciter progressus est, gladium rectum obscurum gerens et ad ictum paratus.

source: At that moment, Mad Lady’s chest was overwhelmed by an intense surge of desire.
target: Illo momento, pectus Mad Lady impetu vehementi desiderii oppressum est.

source: Then, she experienced a sharp, piercing pain.
target: Tum acutum ac percutiens dolorem sensit.

source: She didn’t need to lower her head.
target: Non debuit caput inclinare.

source: From the corner of her eye, she witnessed the flesh on her chest tearing apart inch by inch, the white bones snapping one by one.
target: Ex angulo oculi, vidit carnem in pectore suo ad puncta discidi et ossa alba singillatimrumpi.

source: A grayish‑white fog, mingled with fragments of flesh, surged forth, coalescing into a humanoid figure resembling her.
target: Nebula cinereo‑alba, cum fragmentis carnis mixtis, erupit, coalescens in figuram humanoidem, ei similem.

source: In an instant, it leaped out of the dark “sphere” created by Lumian and darted into the depths of the metal tunnel.
target: In momento, ex sphaera obscura a Lumiano creata, exsiluit et in profundum tuneli metallici procurrit.

source: Don’t be in a hurry to leave!
target: Noli festinare discedere!

source: Unfazed by the situation, Mad Lady’s face reflected excitement and a hint of regret.
target: Indifferens re, vultus Mad Lady excitamentum atque insinuationem paenitentiae exprimebat.

source: Pfft!
target: Pfft!

source: Mr. K’s dark broadsword cleaved through the dark sphere, diagonally bisecting Mad Lady.
target: Gladius obscurus rectus Mr. K per sphaeram obscuram secavit, dividens Mad Lady diagonaliter.

source: Wearing the ring imbued with flesh and blood magic, Mad Lady didn’t succumb immediately.
target: Portans anulum magicum carnis et sanguinis infusum, Mad Lady statim non cedere potuit.

source: Her two halves of flesh and blood writhed, attempting to reunite, but all endeavors were obliterated by the profound darkness left in the wake of the broadsword.
target: Duae quotae carnis et sanguinis eius contorquebantur, conantes se reunire, sed omnes conatus obscuritate profunda post gladium obliti sunt.

source: The flesh and blood failed to reestablish a connection.
target: Caro et sanguis nexum restituere non potuerunt.

source: Come on, come on… Mad Lady’s relatively intact head sought to aid her body, but she swiftly perceived the annihilation of her soul.
target: Age, age… Caput Mad Lady, relativum intactum, quaerebat corpus suum adiuvare, sed celeriter delationem animae suae perceptum est.

source: Her vision darkened, and her unevenly separated bodies crumpled to the ground.
target: Visus eius obscuratus est, et corpora eius, inaequaliter separata, in terram corruerunt.

source: Unperturbed by the fate of the April Fool’s key member, Mr. K and Lumian redirected their focus to the grayish‑white figure hurtling into the depths of the metal tunnel.
target: Non perturbati de fato membri clavis “April Fool”, Mr. K et Lumian conspectum converterunt ad figuram cinereo‑albam, in profundum tuneli metallici labentem.

source: Comprising half fog and half flesh, the figure existed in a realm between reality and illusion.
target: Ex dimidia nebula et dimidia carne constituta, figura in regno inter rem et illusionem exstabat.

source: The temporary Governor of the Sea, Lumian, once again honed in on the target and its surroundings, intending to marshal every ounce of sea power at his disposal.
target: Praefectus maris temporarius, Lumian iterum in metam eiusque circumiecta se vertit, omnem potentiam maris sibi adhibere studens.

source: At that moment, the grayish‑white figure collapsed to the ground.
target: Illo momento, figura cinereo‑alba in terram prostrata est.

source: The flesh and blood originally belonging to Mad Lady seeped into the metal floor, and the grayish‑white fog was on the verge of being absorbed.
target: Caro et sanguis, qui primordio Mad Lady erant, in pavimentum metallicum se infuderunt, et nebula cinereo‑alba paene absorpta erat.

source: Abruptly, the entire tunnel trembled.
target: Subito totus tunel tremuit.

source: Lumian once again “saw” the pear‑shaped object fashioned from flesh and skin.
target: Lumian iterum “vidit” obiectum in forma pirae, ex carne et cute confectum.

source: The flesh membrane on its surface buckled once more, outlining a disc‑shaped contour.
target: Membrana carnis in superficie eius iterum deflexa est, figuram disci delineans.

source: A formidable suction force erupted.
target: Vis attrahens formidabilis erupit.

source: Whether Lumian—the temporary Governor of the Sea—or Mr. K, they found themselves irresistibly propelled into the depths of the metal tunnel, as if an invisible hand seized them and drew them toward the core of the silver‑gray behemoth.
target: Sive Lumian—praefectus maris temporarius—sive Mr. K, se irresistibiliter in profunda tuneli metallici propelli invenerunt, quasi manus invisibilis eos ceperit atque ad cor ingentis bestiae cinereo‑argenteae traxerit.

source: Mad Lady’s dismembered corpse and her belongings soared into the air, propelled towards the destination she had fervently yearned for in life.
target: Corpus disiectum Mad Lady et eius possessiones in aerum volaverunt, versus destinatum, quod in vita ferventer desideraverat, propelli.

source: The humanoid form outlined by the grayish‑white fog seeped deeper into the metal floor, absorbing a portion.
target: Figura humanoidea, delineata a nebula cinereo‑alba, in pavimentum metallicum penitus pervenit, partem absorbens.

source: In that moment, Lumian, wielding the temporary authority of the Governor of the Sea, employed his enhanced perception to “see” the flesh‑and‑blood “bird’s nest” deep within the metal tunnel more distinctly than before.
target: Illo momento, Lumian, praefectus maris temporarius auctoritate praeditus, perceptionem suam auget, ut “videat” nidum carnis et sanguinis, profundo in tuneli metallico, magis distincte quam prius.

source: The pear‑shaped object’s flesh and skin caved in, and the starlight and dark matter emanating from the surrounding flesh ropes accelerated their flow.
target: Caro et cutis obiecti formae pirae delapsae sunt, et lumen stellarum atque materia obscura, ex circumjacentibus funibus carnis emanantes, fluxum suum acceleraverunt.

source: Through the taut skin and flesh, Lumian vaguely sensed the object nurtured within the pear‑shaped structure.
target: Per cutem et carnem rigido, Lumian vix sensu percipiebat obiectum, quod intra structuram formae pirae nutritum erat.

source: It resembled a pitch‑black vortex capable of devouring all colors and light.
target: Id simile erat atramento nigro vortico, qui omnes colores et lucem consumere poterat.

source: While not overly large, it featured a disc‑shaped outer edge.
target: Quamvis non ingens, habebat limen disci similem.

source: Wh… Lumian instinctively recalled scientific concepts and simplified scenes his sister Aurore had once explained. He identified a term that matched his observations: A black hole!
target: Heu… Lumian instinctu recordatus est conceptus científicos et scaenas simplicatas quas soror eius Aurore olim explanaverat. Inveni vocabulum quod observationibus suis convenit: “Foramen nigrum!”

source: Did the Abraham family’s ancestor seal a black hole with Amon?
target: An progenitor familiae Abraham cum Amon foramen nigrum sigillavit?

source: A black hole that has yet to fully form and is still nurtured within a mother’s body from a mystical standpoint?
target: Num foramen nigrum, quod adhuc plene formari non potuit et in corpore matris ex prospectu mystico nutritur, sit?

source: Lumian found the idea absurd, straddling the line between scientific and mystical.
target: Lumian ideam absurdam invenit, inter scientificum et mysticum limen transcendens.

source: Simultaneously, he sensed a connection between the “black hole”-like object and another place.
target: Simul sensit nexum inter obiectum simile “foraminis nigri” atque alium locum.

source: A profound, weighty, dense, and terrifying aura loomed over the world.
target: Aura profunda, gravis, densa ac terribilis super mundum imminens erat.

source: With a buzzing sensation, Lumian teetered on the brink of losing consciousness.
target: Cum zumbitu, Lumian in limine conscientiae amittendae trepidabat.

source: Not only was his physical form being drawn towards the flesh and blood “bird’s nest,” but even his thoughts, Spirit Body, and destiny converged in that direction.
target: Non solum forma corporis eius ad “nidum” carnis et sanguinis trahitur, sed etiam cogitationes, Corpus Spirituale, et fatum in eam partem conveniebant.

source: It was the same for Mr. K.
target: Idem etiam pro Mr. K accidebat.

source: One after another, Mad Lady’s fragmented remains and a few belongings floated between them.
target: Unus post alium, fractae reliquiae Mad Lady et quaedam possessiones inter se fluctuabant.

source: Beyond the silver‑gray behemoth, Franca and the others felt an ominous suction emanating from the seabed.
target: Ultra bestiam cinereo‑argenteam, Franca et ceteri sentiebant suctionem ominosam ex fundo maris emanare.

source: It seemed as though a colossal vortex was forming, ready to engulf everything in its vicinity.
target: Videtur quasi ingens vortex formari, paratus omnia in circuitu suo devorare.

source: Splash!
target: Splash!

source: The mountainous azure waves and jade‑green seawater collapsed, filling the seabed.
target: Undae caeruleae montane et aqua maris viride‑smaragdina in fundo maris collapsae sunt, fundum maris replebant.

source: Abruptly, resplendent starlight descended from the sky.
target: Subito, lux stellarum splendens de caelo descendit.

source: Madam Magician materialized, adorned in a deep‑black Warlock robe embroidered with shimmering silver stars.
target: Magistra Magica apparuit, induta in veste nigerrima Warlock, quae stellis argenteis micantibus exornata erat.

source: The wielder of a Major Arcana card extended her right hand toward the silver‑gray behemoth at the seabed.
target: Possessrix cardinis Magni Arcanae, dextram manum protulit versus bestiam cinereo‑argenteam in fundo maris.

source: Her figure appeared in a state of overlap, intermittently clear and blurry.
target: Figura eius apparuit superimposita, interdum perspicua, interdum vix distincta.

source: Each radiant starlight transformed into an illusory door, seamlessly “melding” with the suction force, merging into the silver‑gray behemoth.
target: Quisque lux stellarum, radiantis, in ostium illusorium transformabatur, sine intermissione cum vis attrahente miscens se et in bestiam cinereo‑argenteam coalescens.
